chapter.heading: The Majesty and Condescension of God
chapter.v:
Praise the
Lord!Praise, O servants of the Lord,Praise the name of the Lord! [Rom. 9:24; 10:20 b Is. 63:19]

Blessed be
the name of the LordFrom this time forth and forevermore! [Rom. 10:21 $] [Is. 42:24] [Is. 1:2, 23 event (Ex. 19:16–21; Deut. 10:21;]

From the
rising of the sun to its going downThe Lord’s name is to be praised. [Is. 1:29] [Deut. 32:21]

The Lord
is high above all nations,His glory above the heavens. [Lev. 11:7; Is. 66:17 Lev. 7:18; 19:7] [Deut. 18:11]

Who is
like the Lord our God,Who dwells on high, [Matt. 9:11; Luke 7:39; 18:9-12]

Who humbles
Himself to beholdThe things that are in the heavens and in the earth? [Ps. 50:3 m Ps.] [Deut. 32:34]

He raises
the poor out of the dust,And lifts the needy out of the ash heap, [Ex. 20:5 o Ezek. 18:6 p Is. 57:7; Ezek. 20:27,]

That He
may seat him with princes—With the princes of His people. [Joel 2:14 r Is. 1:9; Amos 9:8,]

He grants
the barren woman a home,Like a joyful mother of children.Praise the Lord! [Matt. 24:22]
